entry.title: Crypto Trading Ban In Nepal Deterring Fraud Victims From Reporting To Authorities, Report Says
entry.summary:
Nepal’s Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), in its Strategic Analysis Report 2024, revealed that the country’s blanket ban on crypto trading has become a significant obstacle for fraud victims seeking to report their cases to authorities.
Digital Asset Ecosystem In Nepal At A Glance
The FIU is a division of Nepal Rastra Bank, the country’s central bank. It monitors and reports suspicious transactions, particularly those linked to illicit activities such as money laundering and terrorism financing.
The report highlighted an increase in fraudsters using techniques like “smurfing,” where large transactions are divided into smaller amounts to avoid detection. Additionally, these fraudsters convert illicit funds into digital currencies, making it harder for authorities to trace or freeze…

Bitcoin Open Interest Has Reached A Fresh High Recently
As pointed out by CryptoQuant community analyst Maartunn in a new post on X, the BTC Open Interest has shot up recently. The “Open Interest” here refers to a metric that keeps track of the total amount of derivatives positions related to Bitcoin that are currently open on all exchanges.
When the value of this indicator goes up, it means the derivatives users are opening up fresh positions on the market. Generally, the overall leverage in the sector rises when this happens, so an increase in the Open Interest can lead to more volatility in the asset’s price.

entry.title: Roland Emmerich Chats New Sci-Fi Show 'Space Nation,' Bitcoin, and AI
entry.summary:
Roland Emmerich and Marco Weber join Decrypt to discuss their in development TV show based on crypto game 'Space Nation Online.'
Emmerich, who will executive produce the upcoming series, is known as the director of Independence Day, The Day After Tomorrow, Stargate, and 2012. As such, many have nicknamed him the 'master of disaster.' Joining him as executive producer is Weber who produced of Igby Goes Down as well as The Thirteenth Floor.
